import os

# Load the workbook
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/160-6/1_160-6_input.xlsx')

# Find all blank rows by checking if all cells in the row are empty

max_row = ws.max_row

# Collect blank row indices (iterate from bottom to top)
blank_rows = []
for row_idx in range(max_row, 0, -1):

    row_values = [ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=col_idx).value for col_idx in range(1, max_col + 1)]
    is_blank = all(v is None or v == "" for v in row_values)
    if is_blank:
        blank_rows.append(row_idx)

print(f"Found {len(blank_rows)} blank rows to delete: {sorted(blank_rows)}")

# Delete blank rows from bottom to top (so indices don't shift)
for row_idx in blank_rows:

    ws.delete_rows(row_idx, 1)

# Verify the result
print("\nAfter deletion:")
print(f"New max row: {ws.max_row}")
for row_idx in range(1, min(ws.max_row + 1, 10)):
    first_cell = ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=1).value
    print(f"Row {row_idx}: {first_cell}")
